questions.q: Right after the Notice to Proceed, the contractor's first activity is:
questions.n: Mobilization brings people and equipment to site.

questions.q: The fee method using the total direct salary expense of the architect and staff times a multiplier, plus reimbursables, is:
questions.n: Multipliers typically start at about 3.0.

questions.q: A request for time extension must be filed within how many days of the delay occurring?
questions.n: Late requests can be denied.

questions.q: Designing in an unfamiliar city, the best source of cost data is:
o: Local architects and designers doing similar projects
A contractor from your home city
questions.n: Local practitioners know local prices.

questions.q: The planned, systematic activities set up before construction to make sure quality requirements will be met are called:
questions.n: QA prevents defects through process; QC inspects and tests the product.

questions.q: In CSI MasterFormat, Special Construction is Division:
questions.n: Division 13 covers pools, special structures and the like.

questions.q: Work that can't be priced normally under the contract is often paid by:
questions.n: Daywork pays labor, equipment and materials actually used.

questions.q: Additions or amendments to the technical specifications are issued as:
questions.n: They add to or change the spec sections.

questions.q: Which drawing belongs to the civil/structural set?
questions.n: Foundations are engineered by civil/structural.

questions.q: Under RA 9266, the person or persons who prepared the plans and specs, personally or under direct supervision, hold:
questions.n: Authorship belongs to the architect who prepared the documents.

questions.q: You have full drawings of an existing building and are fitting a library into part of it. What matters most in the field survey?
questions.n: Drawings won't show noise, and libraries need quiet.

questions.q: PEZA stands for:
questions.n: PEZA administers economic zones.

questions.q: The BAC (Bids and Awards Committee) handles the:
questions.n: BACs run bidding under the procurement law, now RA 12009 (2024), which replaced RA 9184.

questions.q: Beyond construction, an interiors budget's major costs are:
questions.n: FF&E and relocation dominate.

questions.q: The outline listing the types and trade names of materials and finishes is the:
questions.n: It accompanies the drawings.

questions.q: Which does NOT come before architectural design starts?
questions.n: Outline specs come during design development.

questions.q: Instructions issued before bidding that modify the drawings, specs or General Conditions for a specific project are:
questions.n: Special provisions tailor the general conditions.

questions.q: The contractor submits the contract sum breakdown within how many days of receiving the NTP?
questions.n: Fifteen days under the UAP General Conditions.

questions.q: Additional information on the contract documents released to bidders before the bid date is a:
questions.n: Bulletins clarify or amend before bidding closes.

questions.q: To get competitive bids while still controlling quality, write:
o: A base-bid spec with "or approved equal"
questions.n: Named products set the bar; equals allow competition.

questions.q: How does a design concept relate to a programmatic concept?
o: Programmatic concepts are drawings, design concepts are text
A design concept proposes a specific physical way to meet the programmatic concept
questions.n: Programmatic concepts are performance goals; design concepts answer them.

questions.q: The contractor gives the architect written notice before beginning, suspending or resuming work at least:
questions.n: Except for suspensions caused by accidents.

questions.q: In the General Conditions, the person commissioned by the owner to design and supervise, acting personally or through authorized assistants, is the:
questions.n: The architect administers the contract.

questions.q: IFC drawings, "issued for construction," are the:
questions.n: IFC sets are released for building.

questions.q: A hierarchical, deliverable-based breakdown of a project's scope is the:
questions.n: The WBS decomposes the scope into work packages.

questions.q: The printed contract document that sets out procedural and administrative rules is the:
questions.n: The GC governs relationships and procedures.

questions.q: The most accurate cost estimate comes from a:
questions.n: Pricing each measured item is the most precise.

questions.q: Builder's risk insurance covers:
o: Damage to the building while it's under construction
questions.n: It insures the work in progress.

questions.q: The breakdown that sets a reasonable unit cost for each work item in public works is the:
questions.n: Detailed Unit Price Analysis.

questions.q: The highest PCAB contractor category is:
questions.n: Quadruple A is the top license category.

questions.q: The contractor may suspend work if a court or public authority has stopped it, through no fault of his, for:
questions.n: Article 27 of the UAP General Conditions.

questions.q: Selection of an architect by a committee of an institution, corporation or agency comparing several candidates is:
questions.n: Candidates are evaluated against each other.

questions.q: A preamble is found:
o: At the end of the specs
questions.n: It states the parties' intent at the start of the agreement.

questions.q: Which non-compete clause is reasonable?
o: Giving up rights to their past portfolio
Never practicing in the country again
Not soliciting the firm's clients for six months after leaving
questions.n: Restrictions must be limited in time and scope.

questions.q: Preliminary planning shows the approved adjacency matrix can't be fully satisfied. Your best move is to:
o: Tell the client to find a bigger site
Check which adjacencies really need physical connection, then review with the client
Ignore egress codes to make it fit
questions.n: Clarify priorities and decide with the client.

questions.q: The contractor may also suspend if the owner hasn't paid an arbitration award within:
questions.n: Thirty days after the award.

questions.q: Line and grade for a building are determined by the:
questions.n: Licensed surveyors establish lines and levels.

questions.q: Designated on-site areas for parking equipment, vehicles and materials are:
questions.n: Staging areas organize site logistics.

questions.q: Under the UAP General Conditions, the contractor can't claim delay for missing drawings until how long after demanding them?
questions.n: A two-week allowance applies.

questions.q: Which is NOT generally true of programming interviews?
o: They are efficient with the interviewer's time
questions.n: Interviews are time-consuming.

questions.q: The site document asking the designer to clarify a drawing, specification or contract point is the:
questions.n: Request for information.
